title: Head of Corporate Giving, Robert Bosch Stiftung
about: Head of Corporate Giving at the Robert Bosch Stiftung, overseeing the foundation's grant-making across education, social welfare, and civic society in Germany and Europe. With twelve years of experience in philanthropy and programme management, I have designed matched-giving programmes that have mobilised over €40 million in co-donations from private individuals and corporate partners including LBBW. My priority is ensuring every donated euro is matched by rigorous impact evidence.

title: Environmental Giving Lead, Bosch
about: Environmental Giving Lead at Bosch, responsible for the company's nature and biodiversity philanthropy programmes including the Schwarzwald Watershed Restoration Fund and urban greening initiatives across Baden-Württemberg. My philosophy is that corporate giving is most impactful when it targets systemic environmental restoration rather than symbolic gestures, and every project I fund must demonstrate measurable ecological outcomes within five years.

title: Director of Social Impact Partnerships, SAP SE
about: Director of Social Impact Partnerships at SAP SE, connecting the company's technology capabilities with the needs of NGOs and social enterprises in Germany and globally. I oversee SAP's matched-giving programme on the LBBW Legato platform, ensuring donor contributions are amplified through corporate co-investment and the volunteered time of SAP employees embedded in partner NGOs. Previous experience in tech-for-good at Salesforce.org and the German Development Finance Institution.

title: Corporate Responsibility Manager, SAP
Head of Humanitarian Vehicle Programmes, Mercedes-Benz
about: Head of Humanitarian Vehicle Programmes at Mercedes-Benz Group, responsible for the company's donation of adapted vehicles to disaster relief and humanitarian organisations worldwide. With 18 years in the company's sustainability and social responsibility teams, I have coordinated vehicle donations in response to 40 major disasters. I believe our products can do more than move goods and people — they can save lives.

title: Senior Manager, Road Safety & Social Responsibility
Head of Social Giving, Porsche AG
about: Head of Social Giving at Porsche AG, managing the company's philanthropic partnerships with NGOs working on education, solar energy access, and youth employability. I design and oversee Porsche's matched-giving initiatives, including the flagship 'Road to Zero' solar schools programme in Sub-Saharan Africa. My philosophy is that corporate giving should be as precisely engineered as our vehicles — every euro must deliver measurable, audited impact.

title: Corporate Social Responsibility Programme Manager, Porsche
Head of STEM Philanthropy, TRUMPF
about: Head of STEM Education Philanthropy at TRUMPF, managing the company's donation of professional fabrication equipment to schools and its MakerSpace giving programme. I work with state education authorities across Germany to identify schools that will benefit most from high-quality engineering resources, and train teachers to use them effectively. TRUMPF has donated over €15 million in equipment to schools since 2019.

title: Environmental Impact Lead, TRUMPF
Head of Corporate Philanthropy, Würth Group
about: Head of Corporate Philanthropy at Würth Group, overseeing the Würth charitable trust's grant-making in vocational training, healthcare access, and community welfare across Germany. I manage Würth's matched-giving partnership with LBBW Legato and personally review all grant applications to ensure alignment with our priority communities. My background in social work informs a practical, needs-led approach to corporate giving.

title: Healthcare Giving Programme Officer, Würth
Head of Global Social Responsibility, ZF Friedrichshafen
about: Head of Global Social Responsibility at ZF Friedrichshafen, managing the company's international giving programmes including adaptive mobility solutions for disabled people in the Global South and community mental health support in the Lake Constance region. With a background in international development and engineering, I believe companies at the frontier of mobility technology have a particular responsibility to extend access to those excluded by cost or geography.

title: Community Investment Manager, ZF
Head of Philanthropic Finance, Allianz Foundation
about: Head of Philanthropic Finance at the Allianz Foundation, structuring blended finance instruments and donor giving programmes that combine charitable contributions with commercial risk capital to address global challenges. I oversee Allianz's agricultural microinsurance giving initiative and the climate resilience fund for flood-affected German communities. A background in actuarial science and development economics positions me to design giving products that deliver both financial accountability and social impact.

title: Corporate Giving Manager, Allianz
Social Innovation Lead, Festo
Urban Sustainability Giving Manager, Festo
about: Urban Sustainability Giving Manager at Festo, responsible for the company's civic and environmental philanthropy including the automated urban greening programme in Stuttgart and Mannheim. I co-design each installation with city planners and ecologists to ensure it serves both human and natural communities, and I manage the long-term maintenance partnerships that keep each system healthy for its full 20-year lifespan.

title: Head of Sustainable Construction Giving, Heidelberg Materials
about: Head of Sustainable Construction Giving at Heidelberg Materials, managing the foundation fund that subsidises low-carbon building materials in affordable housing and disaster reconstruction projects. With a civil engineering background and 15 years in construction sustainability, I bridge the gap between material science innovation and the social housing developers who need affordable access to greener solutions.

title: Disaster Reconstruction Programme Manager, Heidelberg Materials
Head of Social Responsibility Giving, dm
about: Head of Social Responsibility Giving at dm-drogerie markt, overseeing the company's product donation programme, matched-giving initiatives, and community welfare partnerships. I manage dm's integration support programme for refugee families and the menstrual dignity initiative, coordinating with over 300 NGO partners nationwide. dm's unique retail footprint means our giving reaches communities in every corner of Germany.

title: Community Partnership Manager, dm
Head of Tech for Good, Vector Informatik
about: Head of Tech for Good at Vector Informatik, managing the company's open-source giving programme and disaster technology initiatives. I lead Vector's investment in open-source early warning platforms for climate disasters and digital financial inclusion tools for rural communities in West Africa. With a background in embedded software engineering and 15 years at Vector, I believe our technical expertise is one of the most valuable things we can contribute to society.

title: Digital Inclusion Giving Lead, Vector
Head of Community Energy Giving, EnBW
about: Head of Community Energy Giving at EnBW Energie Baden-Württemberg, running the company's solar philanthropy programme and international clean water initiative. I design giving products that connect EnBW's renewable energy expertise with communities that need affordable, reliable energy the most — from social housing estates in Heilbronn to rural villages in Kenya. EnBW provides all technical planning for solar installations as our non-cash contribution, making donor funds go further.

title: International Clean Water Programme Officer, EnBW
Head of Humanitarian Technology Giving, Liebherr
about: Head of Humanitarian Technology Giving at Liebherr, overseeing the company's programmes that apply precision engineering solutions to humanitarian challenges. The flagship initiative donates solar-powered vaccine cold-chain systems to district health centres in the Sahel. Liebherr provides technical expertise and field maintenance at no cost; donor funds through LBBW Legato cover logistics and community health worker training.

title: Nature Giving Programme Manager, Liebherr
Head of Humanitarian Fleet Giving, Daimler Truck
about: Head of Humanitarian Fleet Giving at Daimler Truck AG, responsible for the company's donated mobile medical unit programme operating in conflict zones through MSF and other international NGO partners. A mechanical engineering background and 20 years in the truck industry give me deep technical knowledge of vehicle adaptation for challenging environments. I believe Daimler Truck's products can reach the places that need them most.

title: Social Cohesion Giving Manager, Daimler Truck
